{{Quote|Would you like me to dispose of these Bek spies, Kandon?|Kandon's bodyguard to Kandon Ark|translated=1|<ref name="kotor" />}}
'''Kandon's bodyguard''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] member of the [[Black Vulkars/Legends|Black Vulkars]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] and the bodyguard of [[Kandon Ark]]. [[Gender/Legends|She]] died when the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] infiltrated the [[Black Vulkar Base]] in order to retrieve the [[Prototype accelerator]] for the [[Hidden Beks]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Now can I kill them, Kandon?''»''<br />''«''Yes, darling. Kill them.|Kandon's bodyguard and Kandon Ark|translated=1|<ref name="kotor" />}}
When Revan and his companions arrived to the garage, where the accelerator was being held, Kandon's bodyguard requested to eliminate the intruders immediately, but Ark, noticing that the [[Republic soldier]] wasn't wearing Hidden Bek colors, offered him a chance to work for the Vulkars by killing [[Gadon Thek]]. Revan, however, refused to do so. The bodyguard then asked again if she could kill them, to which Ark approved. They and the other Vulkars present were promptly killed and Revan acquired the accelerator.<ref name="kotor" />

==Behind the scenes==
Alternatively the player can accept Kandon Ark's offer to join the [[Black Vulkars/Legends|Black Vulkars]] and the bodyguard does not die.
